jarrys_ui_cleanup.config.title: Jarry's UI Cleanup
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.removeRealms.to: Removes the Realms button, notification dot and news icon from every menu.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.removeAdvanceme: Removes the Advancements button from the pause menu and moves the Friends icon next to Statistics. The L key still opens Advancements.
Moves the small title-screen icon buttons (Accessibility, Language, Friends, Mods) to the bottom-left corner, just above the version text, and closes the gap.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.removeTitleAcce: Removes the Accessibility and Language icons from the title screen. Both are still in Options.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.removeFeedbackB: Removes Give Feedback and Report Bugs, and closes the gaps.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.removeChatRepor: Hides the Report Player buttons. Does nothing when No Chat Reports is installed.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.stripChatSignat: Sends your chat and commands without signatures, so they can't be reported. Applies from the next join. Does nothing when No Chat Reports is installed.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.allowSignedChat: On servers that require signed chat, sign normally there so you can still talk. Turn off to block chat on those servers instead (you get a notice, never a kick).
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.hideRecipeBookB: Hides the recipe book button in inventory, crafting and furnace screens (if the book is closed). Off by default.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.skipWorldWarnin: Skips the experimental-settings warning and backup prompt when creating or opening worlds. Version-change backup prompts are kept.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.disableNarrator: Ctrl+B no longer turns the narrator on or off.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.hideTutorialToa: Hides the movement, tree, crafting and other tutorial popups.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.hideChatSecurit: Hides the chat-security warning toast when joining some servers.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.customLoadingSc: Dark crimson loading screen with Jarry's logo instead of the red Mojang screen.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.fasterLoading.t: Skips the loading logo fade-in and closes Loading Terrain as soon as chunks are ready.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.option.darkUiReadableT: With Jarry's Dark UI pack enabled, container titles are drawn light so they stay readable.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.chat.signedHere.title: Signed chat on for this server
jarrys_ui_cleanup.chat.signedHere.body: It requires signatures, so your chat is signed here.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.chat.blocked.title: Chat blocked on this server
jarrys_ui_cleanup.chat.blocked.body: This server requires signed chat and Jarry's UI Cleanup is stripping signatures, so chat is off here. Turn on "Allow Signed Chat If Required" to talk here.
jarrys_ui_cleanup.chat.blocked.send: Not sent: this server requires signed chat and signature stripping is on (UI Cleanup settings).
